original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 Cluster for SaaS multi-tenant application with secure defaults

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-app
    Description: Project or application name for tagging
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues: [prod, staging, dev]
    Description: Deployment environment
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC where the Aurora cluster will be deployed
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of private subnet IDs in at least two AZs for the DB subnet group
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Security Group ID for application servers allowed to access the DB (leave blank to skip)
  AllowedCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional CIDR block allowed to access the DB (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16) (leave blank to skip)
  ClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-aurora-pg
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: DB cluster identifier (used in endpoints and CloudWatch log group names)
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: app
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Initial database name
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: svcdbadmin
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Master username. Password is managed automatically by RDS and stored in Secrets Manager.
  DBEngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '15.4'
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version (e.g., 15.4). Ensure it matches the parameter group family.
  DBFamily:
    Type: String
    Default: aurora-postgresql15
    AllowedPattern: '^aurora-postgresql(11|12|13|14|15|16)$'
    Description: DB parameter group family matching the engine major version (e.g., aurora-postgresql15)
  DBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5432
    Description: Database port
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Backup retention period in days
  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 03:00-04:00
    Description: Preferred backup window (UTC) in hh24:mi-hh24:mi
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: Sun:04:00-Sun:05:00
    Description: Preferred maintenance window (UTC) ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi
  ServerlessMinACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum Aurora capacity units (ACUs) for Serverless v2
  ServerlessMaxACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum Aurora capacity units (ACUs) for Serverless v2
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1096,1827,2192,2557,2922,3288,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch LogGroup retention in days for RDS logs
  EnableIAMAuth:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable IAM database authentication

Conditions:
  HasAppSG: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AppSecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasAllowedCidr: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AllowedCidr, '']]
  EnableIAMDatabaseAuth: !Equals [!Ref EnableIAMAuth, 'true']

Resources:
  RdsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL cluster, Performance Insights, and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-kms
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  RdsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: !Sub Subnet group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-subnets
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Access control for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-sg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SGIngressFromAppSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAppSG
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow DB access from application security group

  SGIngressFromCidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAllowedCidr
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedCidr
      Description: Allow DB access from specified CIDR

  ClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Cluster parameter group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
        log_connections: '1'
        log_disconnections: '1'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        # Enable logging collector and log settings suitable for Aurora PostgreSQL
        log_statement: 'none'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-cluster-param
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InstanceParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Instance parameter group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        track_io_timing: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-instance-param
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-monitoring
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-monitoring
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RdsLogGroupPostgresql:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${ClusterIdentifier}/postgresql
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RdsLogGroupUpgrade:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${ClusterIdentifier}/upgrade
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref ClusterIdentifier
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref DBEngineVersion
      EngineMode: provisioned
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      Port: !Ref DBPort
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref ClusterParameterGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DeletionProtection: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
        - upgrade
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUserSecretKmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMaxACU
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: !If [EnableIAMDatabaseAuth, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-aurora-pg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${ClusterIdentifier}-writer
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref InstanceParameterGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-writer
        - Key: Role
          Value: writer
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${ClusterIdentifier}-reader
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref InstanceParameterGroup
      PromotionTier: 15
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-reader
        - Key: Role
          Value: reader
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  ClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint of the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ClusterEndpoint
  ReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint of the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReaderEndpoint
  MasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the RDS managed master user secret
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MasterUserSecretArn
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID attached to the Aurora cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId
  SubnetGroupName:
    Description: Name of the DB subnet group
    Value: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSubnetGroup

    Description: VPC where the Aurora cluster will be deployed
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of private subnet IDs in at least two AZs for the DB subnet group
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Security Group ID for application servers allowed to access the DB (leave blank to skip)
  AllowedCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional CIDR block allowed to access the DB (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16) (leave blank to skip)
  ClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-aurora-pg
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: DB cluster identifier (used in endpoints and CloudWatch log group names)
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: app
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Initial database name
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: svcdbadmin
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Master username. Password is managed automatically by RDS and stored in Secrets Manager.
  DBEngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '15.4'
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version (e.g., 15.4). Ensure it matches the parameter group family.
  DBFamily:
    Type: String
    Default: aurora-postgresql15
    AllowedPattern: '^aurora-postgresql(11|12|13|14|15|16)$'
    Description: DB parameter group family matching the engine major version (e.g., aurora-postgresql15)
  DBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5432
    Description: Database port
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Backup retention period in days
  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 03:00-04:00
    Description: Preferred backup window (UTC) in hh24:mi-hh24:mi
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: Sun:04:00-Sun:05:00
    Description: Preferred maintenance window (UTC) ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi
  ServerlessMinACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum Aurora capacity units (ACUs) for Serverless v2
  ServerlessMaxACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum Aurora capacity units (ACUs) for Serverless v2
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1096,1827,2192,2557,2922,3288,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch LogGroup retention in days for RDS logs
  EnableIAMAuth:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable IAM database authentication

Conditions:
  HasAppSG: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AppSecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasAllowedCidr: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AllowedCidr, '']]
  EnableIAMDatabaseAuth: !Equals [!Ref EnableIAMAuth, 'true']

Resources:
  RdsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL cluster, Performance Insights, and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-kms
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
  RdsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: !Sub Subnet group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-subnets
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Access control for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-sg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SGIngressFromAppSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAppSG
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow DB access from application security group

  SGIngressFromCidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAllowedCidr
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedCidr
      Description: Allow DB access from specified CIDR

  ClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Cluster parameter group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
        log_connections: '1'
        log_disconnections: '1'
        shared_preload_libraries: 'pg_stat_statements'
        # Enable logging collector and log settings suitable for Aurora PostgreSQL
        log_statement: 'none'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-cluster-param
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InstanceParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Instance parameter group for ${ProjectName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        track_io_timing: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '1000'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-instance-param
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-monitoring
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rds-monitoring
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RdsLogGroupPostgresql:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${ClusterIdentifier}/postgresql
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RdsLogGroupUpgrade:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/rds/cluster/${ClusterIdentifier}/upgrade
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref ClusterIdentifier
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref DBEngineVersion
      EngineMode: provisioned
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      Port: !Ref DBPort
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref ClusterParameterGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DeletionProtection: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
        - upgrade
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUserSecretKmsKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref ServerlessMaxACU
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: !If [EnableIAMDatabaseAuth, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-aurora-pg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${ClusterIdentifier}-writer
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref InstanceParameterGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-writer
        - Key: Role
          Value: writer
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${ClusterIdentifier}-reader
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      PerformanceInsightsEnabled: true
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !Ref RdsKmsKey
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref InstanceParameterGroup
      PromotionTier: 15
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-db-reader
        - Key: Role
          Value: reader
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  ClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint of the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ClusterEndpoint
  ReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint of the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReaderEndpoint
  MasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the RDS managed master user secret
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MasterUserSecretArn
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID attached to the Aurora cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId
  SubnetGroupName:
    Description: Name of the DB subnet group
    Value: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSubnetGroup
